messages:
jess: Heads up — saw a sharp QoS spike hitting a subset of requests on shared-gpu-pool-7, 99p latency doubled around 06:12 UTC. Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/perf?s=shared-gpu-pool-7 :eyes:
omar: saw it too. correlates with a few long tail batches on kernel-v2 path. attaching quick profiler snapshot in a sec.
infra-bot: [ALERT] High p99 latency detected on shared-gpu-pool-7 at 2026-03-18T06:12:03Z. metric=p99_latency_ms value=612 threshold=300
liam: any tenant IDs? can we isolate noisy tenant?
sophia: quick query shows spike coincides with tenant:analytics-proxy (tenant_id=ta-843). They had a batch job starting 06:10.
jess: yep ta-843 looks suspicious. logs: 
```
2026-03-18T06:10:12Z ta-843 request=start seq=0 len=2048 model=redwood/open-13b
2026-03-18T06:10:12Z ta-843 batch_size=32 kernel=autoselect -> forced_kernels=[v2, fallback-quant]
```
omar: profiler summary (06:10-06:14):
- kernel switch events: 146 (v1->v2 toggles on long sequences)
- KV cache evictions: 12k evict ops/min on pool-7
- avg batch assemble time +18ms on v2 path
Full trace: /tmp/prof-1950032100.txt
liam: 12k evictions sounds like KV thrash. ta-843 may be streaming large contexts causing slot churn.
sophia: also saw increased kernel selection churn in autoscaler: "if seq_len > 1024 -> prefer v2" logic is flapping because some requests have mixed seq lengths.
jess: hypothesis: mixed-size workload from ta-843 causes autoswitching between v1 and v2 kernels mid-epoch, which invalidates KV slot reservations and triggers evictions -> cold KV reads and tail latency.
omar: repro plan: route a copy of ta-843's load to dev pool and run with kernel-locking (force kernel=v2) and a pinned KV slot budget. compare p99.
liam: quick mitigation: add a per-tenant kernel-sticky policy for ta-843 and conservative max-batch-size=16 to reduce churn. can we push via runtime feature flag?
sophia: I can flip feature flag runtime/tenant/ta-843/kernel-sticky=true now. Applying...
infra-bot: [CONFIG] runtime flag runtime/tenant/ta-843/kernel-sticky set to true by sophia at 2026-03-18T06:18:02Z
jess: rolling config to pool-7 nodes...
omar: after flag: p99 dropped from 612ms -> 280ms within two minutes. KV eviction rate also fell ~70%. early win but need durable fix.
liam: long term: update autosel logic to consider recent kernel history + tenant affinity window to avoid flip-flopping for mixed workloads. also add per-tenant kv-slot-rate-limit to protect pool.
sophia: filing followup task and perf regression test: plan -> add synthetic mixed-length trace to CI, ensure no kernel churn under steady state. putting PR for autosel heuristics.
jess: thanks. action items: 
- omar run full replay on dev pool with forced kernel and collect perf traces (due EOD)
- liam propose autosel heuristic change + kv rate limiter design (due +2 days)
- sophia add regression test + flag cleanup plan (due +3 days)
- infra: consider temporary per-tenant qps cap for ta-843 until autosel patch (deployed)
omar: starting replay now, linking results: s3://perf-replays/1950032100/replay.tar.gz
liam: FYI @eng-sre we might throttle ta-843 if they don't agree to staged rollout — pinging ops to coordinate.
sophia: noted, will draft customer note if we need beta opt-in for kernel-sticky.
jess: great work. will close incident once autosel change lands and regression proves green. :thumbsup:
